scholarships.name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS-G) for Graduate Degrees
exclusions: Korean citizenship or dual citizenship (applicant or parents)
Graduated or expected to graduate from a Korean high school or university

language.note: TOPIK not required to apply; TOPIK 3+ needed after 1-year Korean course

scholarships.duration: master 3 years (1 language + 2 degree), doctoral 4 years (1 + 3)
scholarships.applicationPeriod: Embassy track 2026-02-12 to 2026-02-25 (2026 round); next round expected early 2027

evidence.nationality: must hold citizenship of NIIED designated countries

scholarships.reviewNotes: Confirm benefit amounts in the official table; 2027 guidelines not yet published.

scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarship
conditions: Citizen of a Chevening-eligible country
Return to country of award for at least 2 years after the award
At least 2 years (2,800 hours) work experience after undergraduate degree
Undergraduate degree completed at least 2 years before the deadline
Apply to 3 eligible UK courses; unconditional offer from one by the deadline
exclusions: Resident in the UK at time of application
Previous UK government-funded scholarship study in the UK
benefits: Fully funded one-year master's (tuition, living allowance, travel)
scholarships.reviewNotes: Check Myanmar on the country list (chevening.org/scholarship/ country pages). Benefit details not on eligibility page.

scholarships.name: NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship)
scholarships.provider: Dutch Ministry of Education and participating institutions
conditions: Non-EEA nationality
Full-time bachelor's or master's at a participating institution
Meet the institution's admission requirements
No previous degree from a Dutch institution
benefits: EUR 5,000 in the first year (not full tuition)
scholarships.applicationPeriod: 2027-2028 round open; deadlines set by each institution

evidence.priorStudy: You do not have a degree from an education institution in the Netherlands.

scholarships.reviewNotes: Participating institutions change yearly: check whether TU Delft, TU/e, Twente, Groningen, Maastricht are on the 2027-2028 list.

scholarships.name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship (GOI-IES)
conditions: Domiciliary of origin outside EU/EEA, Switzerland and UK
Not a Russian or Belarusian citizen
Offer (conditional or final) from an eligible Irish HEI
Full-time NFQ level 9 or 10 programme of at least one year
scholarships.academicNote: Record of outstanding academic achievement; minimum 60/100 marks overall
benefits: Full tuition and registration fee waiver for one year
scholarships.applicationPeriod: 2026 round deadline 2026-03-12; 2027 call expected late 2026 / early 2027

evidence.nationality: Have a domiciliary of origin outside the EU/EEA, Switzerland and the United Kingdom

scholarships.reviewNotes: Myanmar not named; inferred from domicile rule. Check FAQs.

scholarships.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
scholarships.provider: US Department of State (via binational commission or US Embassy)
conditions: Apply through the Fulbright Commission or US Embassy in home country
Reside in country of nomination when applying
US bachelor's equivalent by start date with good academic record
exclusions: US citizens and dual US citizens
scholarships.reviewNotes: Myanmar program reopened per 2026 news reports, but no official US Embassy Burma page confirmed yet. Find embassy notice.
